BETA Close X Sage Group PLC announced the purchase of 1,443,204 ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities. The highest price paid per share was 878.2000 pence, the lowest was 859.8000 pence, and the volume-weighted average price paid was 869.0361 pence. These shares were purchased from J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of the share buyback program announced on March 2, 2026, which is scheduled to conclude by June 5, 2026. Sage intends to cancel all acquired shares. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 12 May 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
